related.title: IBM 類型讀出：色散位移與失諧尺度
related.titleEn: IBM-style readout: dispersive shift and detuning scale
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付功率頻譜、Q反算與內外損耗區分表。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver power spectra, inverse Q and an internal/external loss distinction table. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IBM 類型讀出：色散位移與失諧尺度』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付色散近似有效區、符號慣例與待補的非諧性資料。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM-style readout: dispersive shift and detuning scale', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver a dispersive-validity region, sign convention and missing anharmonicity data.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：載入Q=f0/Δf；Δf為功率半高全寬。不能把振幅半高寬或角頻率混用。 使用合成f0=6 GHz、Q=10000；頻寬以MHz表示。 以手算或試算表計算名義式6e9/10000/1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：由兩個半功率頻點相減得到Δf，再反算Q；檢查掃頻解析度至少小於0.06 MHz。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：兩能階近似χ=g²/Δ，以循環頻率一致代入可得χ/2π；真實transmon還含非諧性修正。 使用合成g/2π=50 MHz、Δ/2π=1000 MHz；abs(g/Δ)=0.05。 以手算或試算表計算名義式50**2/1000，另開一欄執行獨立核對：檢查χΔ=g²在兩組相同；另把Δ改50 MHz，標記近似失效而非接受巨大位移。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Loaded Q=f0/Δf with power full width at half maximum; do not substitute amplitude half-height width or angular frequency. Use Synthetic f0=6 GHz and Q=10000; express bandwidth in MHz. Evaluate nominal expression 6e9/10000/1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Subtract half-power frequencies to obtain Δf and invert Q; require sweep resolution below0.06 MHz.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Two-level approximation χ=g²/Δ yields χ/2π when cyclic frequencies are used consistently; real transmons require anharmonicity corrections. Use Synthetic g/2π=50 MHz and Δ/2π=1000 MHz give abs(g/Δ)=0.05. Evaluate nominal expression 50**2/1000 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check χΔ=g² in both cases; set Δ=50 MHz separately and flag approximation failure rather than accepting a large shift.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 超導讀出時序：共振器光子排空
related.titleEn: Superconducting readout timing: resonator photon depletion
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付功率頻譜、Q反算與內外損耗區分表。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver power spectra, inverse Q and an internal/external loss distinction table. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『超導讀出時序：共振器光子排空』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付光子／場振幅雙公式、排空曲線與時間窗驗收。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Superconducting readout timing: resonator photon depletion', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver separate photon/field laws, depletion curves and timing-window acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：載入Q=f0/Δf；Δf為功率半高全寬。不能把振幅半高寬或角頻率混用。 使用合成f0=6 GHz、Q=10000；頻寬以MHz表示。 以手算或試算表計算名義式6e9/10000/1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：由兩個半功率頻點相減得到Δf，再反算Q；檢查掃頻解析度至少小於0.06 MHz。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：能量／光子數n(t)=n0 exp(−κt)；場振幅則以κ/2衰減，兩者不可混用。 使用合成κ=2π×2 MHz、n0=10、等待t=200 ns。 以手算或試算表計算名義式10*exp(-2*pi*2e6*200e-9)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以兩次200 ns衰減因子相乘重現400 ns結果；若誤用場振幅式將高估殘留。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Loaded Q=f0/Δf with power full width at half maximum; do not substitute amplitude half-height width or angular frequency. Use Synthetic f0=6 GHz and Q=10000; express bandwidth in MHz. Evaluate nominal expression 6e9/10000/1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Subtract half-power frequencies to obtain Δf and invert Q; require sweep resolution below0.06 MHz.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Energy/photon number n(t)=n0 exp(−κt); field amplitude decays atκ/2, so do not mix them. Use Synthetic κ=2π×2 MHz, n0=10 and wait t=200 ns. Evaluate nominal expression 10*exp(-2*pi*2e6*200e-9) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Multiply two200 ns decay factors to reproduce400 ns; using the field-amplitude law overestimates remaining photons.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
